name: MLLMU-Bench
description:
Protecting Privacy in Multimodal Large Language Models with MLLMU-Bench
	


	
		
		Abstract
	

Generative models such as Large Language Models (LLM) and Multimodal Large Language models (MLLMs) trained on massive web corpora can memorize and disclose individuals' confidential and private data, raising legal and ethical concerns. While many previous works have addressed this issue in LLM via machine unlearning, it remains largely unexplored for MLLMs. To tackle this challenge, we… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/oceanoceanna/MLLMU-Bench.
reputation: A recently proposed benchmark for privacy leakage in MLLMs; of emerging interest to researchers studying model memorization and data privacy but not yet widely adopted.
